name: Second Guessing
source:
From having weird dreams over and over again, Takumi finds himself not able to focus well on his job. It's a good thing his childhood friend, Karua, and his boss Sirei have come to help! 
The idea of one-day-date raffle dating for a fan has come to fruition! Almost having second thoughts, Takumi goes along with this idea.
 
What's the worst that could happen?  
(taken from itch.io page)
